questions.question: The ages of three siblings are x , 25, and 2x + 8 years, arranged in ascending order. The total ages of the youngest and the eldest is double the age of the third sibling. What is the age (in years) of the eldest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Youngest = x, middle = 25, eldest = 2x + 8

Condition: x + (2x + 8) = 2 × 25

3x + 8 = 50 ⇒ 3x = 42 ⇒ x = 14

Eldest = 2x + 8 = 36

**∴ Answer = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ages are x, 25, and 2x + 8 in ascending order

**Formula used:**

Sum of youngest and eldest = 2 × (middle age)

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + (2x + 8) = 2 × 25

⇒ 3x + 8 = 50

⇒ 3x = 42

⇒ x = 14

⇒ Eldest = 2x + 8 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Concept

Equation of form ax + b = c is solved as x = (c − b) ÷ a

Age Equation Formation

Translate statements into algebra: sum or multiple relations form linear equations

Ascending Order Rule

x < 25 < 2x + 8 ensures correct identification of youngest and eldest

Verification Method

Check: 14 + 36 = 50 and 2 × 25 = 50, condition satisfied

questions.question: Two trains, 136 metres and 144 metres in length are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 65 km/hr and the second at the rate of 79 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?3629
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 136 + 144 = 280 m

Relative speed (opposite) = 65 + 79 = 144 km/hr

Convert speed: 144 × (5/18) = 40 m/s

Time = 280 ÷ 40 = 7 sec

**∴ Answer = 7 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of trains = 136 m and 144 m

Speeds = 65 km/hr and 79 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 136 + 144 = 280 m

⇒ Relative speed (opposite direction) = 65 + 79 = 144 km/hr

⇒ Convert into m/s: 144 × 5 ÷ 18 = 40 m/s

⇒ Time = 280 ÷ 40 = 7 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 7 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add: Relative speed = v1 + v2

Train Crossing Rule

When two trains cross, total distance = sum of their lengths

Speed Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

Time Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

questions.question: Pipe P can fill (3)/(8) part of a tank in 30 hours and pipe Q can fill (3)/(5) part of the same tank in 48 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 4 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 6 hours. Pipes P , Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for P to fill the tank = 30 × 8/3 = 80 hrs, and for Q = 48 × 5/3 = 80 hrs.

Work done by P and Q in 4 hrs = 4 × (1/80 + 1/80) = 4 × 2/80 = 1/10 part.

Pipe R empties this 1/10 part in 6 hrs, so R empties the full tank in 60 hrs.

Net part filled in 1 hr by P, Q and R = 1/80 + 1/80 − 1/60 = 1/40 − 1/60 = 1/120.

Time taken by P, Q and R together to fill the tank = 120 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 hours.**

questions.question: If the third proportional of 9 and 51 be x , then what is the value of x ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two given numbers a and b, the third proportional c is calculated using the formula c = b² ÷ a.

Here, a = 9 and b = 51.

Third proportional = (51 × 51) ÷ 9

⇒ Third proportional = 2601 ÷ 9 = 289

**∴ The correct answer is 289.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First proportional (a) = 9

Second proportional (b) = 51

**Formula Used:**

If x is the third proportional to a and b, then they are in continued proportion: a : b :: b : x, which simplifies to a × x = b².

 Continued Proportion: a : b :: b : c

 :

 :

 3rd Term

 Formula: b² = a × c ⇒ 51 × 51 = 9 × x

**Calculations:**

⇒ 9 : 51 :: 51 : x

⇒ 9 ÷ 51 = 51 ÷ x

⇒ 9 × x = 51 × 51

⇒ 9x = 2601

⇒ x = 2601 ÷ 9

⇒ x = 289

**∴ The correct answer is 289.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b). It represents the geometric mean of the two numbers in a continued proportion.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d satisfies a : b :: c : d. This yields the formula d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together term by term, the resulting ratio is called a compound ratio. For instance, the compound ratio of a:b and c:d is (a × c) : (b × d).

questions.question: A and B working together can complete a piece of work in 2 days. B alone can complete the same work in 4 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to complete double the work?2523
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If A and B complete a work in 'x' days and B alone in 'y' days, time taken by A alone = (x × y) ÷ (y − x) days.

Time for A alone = (2 × 4) ÷ (4 − 2) = 4 days.

For double the work, time taken = 4 × 2 = 8 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A and B together = 2 days

Time taken by B alone = 4 days

**Calculations:**

 **Efficiency**

⇒ Efficiency of A = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of B

⇒ Efficiency of A = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time taken by A alone to complete the total work = 4 ÷ 1 = 4 days

⇒ Target work = Double the total work = 2 × 4 = 8 units

⇒ Time taken to complete double the work = 8 ÷ 1 = 8 days

Pipes & Cisterns

Follows the exact same logic as Time & Work. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency, and outlet pipes (leaks) have negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Total wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each individual. If they work for the same number of days, wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Days Work

When working on alternate days, find the total work completed in one full cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 persons) and use it to reach near the total work.

questions.question: A dealer makes a profit of 50% even after giving a 25% discount on the advertised price of a bike. If he makes a profit of ₹1,290 on the sale of the bike, what is the advertised price (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let CP = 100

Profit = 50% ⇒ SP = 150

Discount = 25% ⇒ SP = 75% of MP

⇒ MP = 150 ÷ 0.75 = 200

Profit = 50 ⇒ actual profit = 1290 ⇒ multiply by 25.8 ⇒ MP = 200 × 25.8 = 5160

**∴ Answer = 5160**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit = 50%, Discount = 25%, Profit amount = 1290

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + profit%) and SP = MP × (1 − discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = x

⇒ Profit = 50% ⇒ SP = 1.5x

⇒ Discount = 25% ⇒ SP = 0.75 × MP

⇒ 1.5x = 0.75 × MP

⇒ MP = (1.5x ÷ 0.75) = 2x

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 1.5x − x = 0.5x

⇒ 0.5x = 1290 ⇒ x = 2580

⇒ MP = 2x = 5160

**∴ The correct answer is 5160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

Profit = SP − CP and Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − discount%)

Assumption Method

Assume CP = 100 to quickly find ratio between MP and CP

Link Between CP and MP

Using SP as common link helps relate CP and MP easily

questions.question: If 60% of 30% of (1)/(3) of a number is 204, find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly convert given percentages to fractional values: 60% = 3 ÷ 5 and 30% = 3 ÷ 10

Multiply the fractions: 3 ÷ 5 × 3 ÷ 10 × 1 ÷ 3 = 3 ÷ 50

Equate the resultant fraction to the given value: 3 ÷ 50 of Number = 204

Number = 204 × 50 ÷ 3 = 68 × 50 = 3400

**∴ The correct answer is 3400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

60% of 30% of 1 ÷ 3 of a number = 204

**Formula Used:**

x% = x ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

Let the unknown number be x.

⇒ (60 ÷ 100) × (30 ÷ 100) × (1 ÷ 3) × x = 204

⇒ (6 ÷ 10) × (3 ÷ 10) × (1 ÷ 3) × x = 204

⇒ (3 ÷ 5) × (3 ÷ 10) × (1 ÷ 3) × x = 204

⇒ (3 × 3 × 1) ÷ (5 × 10 × 3) × x = 204

⇒ 9 ÷ 150 × x = 204

⇒ 3 ÷ 50 × x = 204

⇒ x = (204 × 50) ÷ 3

⇒ x = 68 × 50

⇒ x = 3400

**∴ The correct answer is 3400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Equivalents of Percentages

To speed up calculations in the exam, memorize the standard fraction values for common percentages. For example, 20% = 1 ÷ 5, 25% = 1 ÷ 4, 30% = 3 ÷ 10, and 60% = 3 ÷ 5.

BODMAS Rule

In mathematical expressions, the word 'of' means multiplication but acts with a higher precedence than standard division and multiplication according to the BODMAS simplification rules.

Cross-Multiplication

When moving a fraction to the opposite side of an equation, multiply the constant by the reciprocal of the fraction. If (a ÷ b) × x = c, then x = c × (b ÷ a).

questions.question: A rectangle has a perimeter of 64 cm. If its length is 8 cm more than its width, find the width of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of length and width = Perimeter ÷ 2 = 64 ÷ 2 = 32 cm.

Difference between length and width = 8 cm.

Width = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2

Width = (32 − 8) ÷ 2 = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 64 cm

Length (L) = Width (W) + 8 cm

 
 L = W + 8
 W
 Perimeter = 64 cm
 W = 12 cm, L = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter = 2 × (L + W)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (W + 8 + W) = 64

⇒ 2W + 8 = 32

⇒ 2W = 32 − 8

⇒ 2W = 24

⇒ W = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Rectangle

The region enclosed by the rectangle is its area, given by Area = L × W.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

The straight line connecting opposite corners is its diagonal, given by D = √(L² + W²).

Perimeter of a Square

If L = W, the shape is a square and its perimeter is given by Perimeter = 4 × Side.
</p

questions.question: Manu purchased a microwave for ₹ 12,000 and sold it to Anuj at a loss of 12.5%. Anuj sold it to Rani at a profit of 20% and Rani sold it to Priya at a profit of 6(2)/(3)\% . Find the price at which Priya purchased it.

questions.question: If the LCM of two numbers is 192 and their HCF is 32. If the first number is 64, find the second number.3197
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The product of two numbers is equal to the product of their LCM and HCF.

Second number = (LCM × HCF) ÷ First number

Second number = (192 × 32) ÷ 64

Second number = 192 × (32 ÷ 64) = 192 ÷ 2 = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of two numbers = 192

HCF of two numbers = 32

First number = 64

**Formula Used:**

First Number × Second Number = LCM × HCF

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the second number be x.

⇒ 64 × x = 192 × 32

⇒ x = (192 × 32) ÷ 64

⇒ x = 192 × (32 ÷ 64)

⇒ x = 192 × (1 ÷ 2)

⇒ x = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Rule

For any two positive integers A and B, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their LCM and HCF. (A × B = LCM × HCF)

Co-prime Numbers Property

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. In such cases, the LCM is simply the product of the two numbers.

Fraction Rule

LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators). Similarly, HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators).
</p

questions.question: The average of 13 numbers is 7. If each number is multiplied by 2, then what will the new average be?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If every number in a dataset is multiplied by a constant 'k', the new average also gets multiplied by 'k'.

Given original average = 7

Since each number is multiplied by 2, the new average = 7 × 2

New average = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of values = 13

Average of these 13 numbers = 7

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
 Original Avg = 7
 
• 
 

 Multiply by 2
 
 New Avg = 14

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the 13 numbers = Average × 13

⇒ Original Sum = 7 × 13 = 91

⇒ If each number is multiplied by 2, the new sum becomes twice the original sum.

⇒ New Sum = 91 × 2 = 182

⇒ New Average = New Sum ÷ Number of values

⇒ New Average = 182 ÷ 13

⇒ New Average = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Addition Property of Averages

If a constant value 'x' is added to every observation in a dataset, the new average becomes (Original Average + x).

Subtraction Property of Averages

If a constant value 'y' is subtracted from every observation in a dataset, the new average becomes (Original Average − y).

Division Property of Averages

If every observation in a dataset is divided by a non-zero constant 'z', the new average becomes (Original Average ÷ z).
</p

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹83,000. He saves 16% of his income. If his income increases by 22% and expenditure increases by 25%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial saving = 16% of 83000 = 13280

Expenditure = 84% of 83000 = 69720

New income = 83000 × 1.22 = 101260

New expenditure = 69720 × 1.25 = 87150

New saving = 101260 − 87150 = 14110

Increase = 14110 − 13280 = 830

**∴ Answer = ₹830**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 83000, Saving = 16%

Income increases by 22%, Expenditure increases by 25%

**Formula used:**

Saving = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial saving = 0.16 × 83000 = 13280

⇒ Initial expenditure = 83000 − 13280 = 69720

⇒ New income = 83000 × 1.22 = 101260

⇒ New expenditure = 69720 × 1.25 = 87150

⇒ New saving = 101260 − 87150 = 14110

⇒ Increase in saving = 14110 − 13280 = 830

**∴ The correct answer is ₹830.**

questions.question: If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 17% and its height is increased by 138%, then what is the percentage increase (rounded off to the closest integer) in its volume?

New h = 2.38h

**∴ Answer = 64% increase**

⇒ = πr²h × (0.83)² × 2.38

⇒ = Original volume × (0.6889 × 2.38)

⇒ = Original volume × 1.6396

⇒ % increase = (1.6396 − 1) × 100 = 63.96% ≈ 64%

**∴ The correct answer is 64% increase.**

questions.question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (2)/(70)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Required Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

Target = 1/20, Base = 2/70

Percentage = (1/20 ÷ 2/70) × 100 = (1/20 × 70/2) × 100

Percentage = (70/40) × 100 = (7/4) × 100 = 175%

**∴ The correct answer is 175%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Target fraction = 1/20

Base fraction = 2/70

 
 Base: 2/70 = 100%
 
 Target: 1/20 = ?%
 
•

• 
 100%
 175%

**Formula Used:**

Required Percentage = (Given Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the required percentage be x%.

⇒ (x / 100) × (2 / 70) = 1 / 20

⇒ x = (1 / 20) × (70 / 2) × 100

⇒ x = (70 / 40) × 100

⇒ x = (7 / 4) × 100

⇒ x = 7 × 25

⇒ x = 175

**∴ The correct answer is 175%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Concept

Percentage is a number or ratio that represents a fraction of 100. It is denoted by the symbol %.

Base Value in Percentage

The value that follows 'is what percent of' or 'more/less than' is always considered as the base value (denominator). Here, 2/70 is the base.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert a fraction a/b into a percentage, multiply it by 100. For example, 1/4 = (1/4) × 100 = 25%.

Percentage Increase

If a value increases from A to B, the percentage increase is [(B − A) ÷ A] × 100.

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Ajay borrowed an amount of ₹2,40,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Ajay after 4 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in interest rates between Bank B and Bank A = 7.5% − 3.5% = 4% per annum.

Total difference in simple interest over a period of 4 years = 4% × 4 = 16%.

Difference in interest amount paid = 16% of ₹2,40,000.

Difference = (16 ÷ 100) × 2,40,000 = ₹38,400.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹38,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,40,000

Interest Rate of Bank A (R₁) = 3.5%

Interest Rate of Bank B (R₂) = 7.5%

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 Principal = ₹2,40,000 
• 
• Bank A: 3.5% Time = 4 years Bank B: 7.5% Time = 4 years 
• Diff = 4% / yr Total Difference = 16% of P 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Simple Interest paid to Bank A = (2,40,000 × 3.5 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ SI for Bank A = 2400 × 14 = ₹33,600

⇒ Simple Interest paid to Bank B = (2,40,000 × 7.5 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ SI for Bank B = 2400 × 30 = ₹72,000

⇒ Positive difference = SI from Bank B − SI from Bank A

⇒ Difference = ₹72,000 − ₹33,600 = ₹38,400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹38,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Difference Formula

When the principal and time period are exactly the same, the difference in simple interest can be calculated directly without finding individual interests: Difference = P × T × (R₂ − R₁) ÷ 100.

Simple Interest Nature

Simple Interest remains strictly constant every year as it is calculated only on the initial principal. This linear growth is what enables direct subtraction of interest rates before applying them to the principal.

Total Amount Formula

The total amount paid or received at the end of the borrowing period is the sum of the Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Mean

questions.question: Simplify ((x² - 15x + 50))/((x - 10)) .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In fractions like this, the denominator is usually a direct factor of the numerator.

Since the denominator is (x − 10), we can assume (x − 10) is a factor of x² − 15x + 50.

The constant term is +50. If one factor is (x − 10), the other must be (x − 5) because (−10) × (−5) = 50.

So, (x − 10)(x − 5) ÷ (x − 10) = x − 5.

**∴ The correct answer is x − 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = (x² − 15x + 50) ÷ (x − 10)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us factorise the quadratic numerator: x² − 15x + 50

⇒ We need two numbers that multiply to 50 and add up to −15. These numbers are −10 and −5.

⇒ x² − 10x − 5x + 50

⇒ x(x − 10) − 5(x − 10)

⇒ (x − 10)(x − 5)

⇒ Substituting this factored form back into the original fraction:

⇒ [(x − 10)(x − 5)] ÷ (x − 10)

⇒ The term (x − 10) cancels out from both the numerator and the denominator.

⇒ Result = x − 5

**∴ The correct answer is x − 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Factor Theorem

If a polynomial P(x) has a value of 0 at x = a, then (x − a) is a factor of the polynomial P(x).

Remainder Theorem

When a polynomial P(x) is divided by a linear polynomial (x − a), the remainder is equal to P(a).

Splitting the Middle Term

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, split the middle term bx into two terms such that their sum is b and their product is a × c.

Algebraic Identity

A standard identity used for expanding factored linear equations is (x + a)(x + b) = x² + (a + b)x + ab.

questions.question: Zakir travels from City A to City B. If Zakir drives his car at (3)/(8) th of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 10 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Zakir would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.

Speed reduced to 3/8 ⇒ time increases by 8/3 times

Extra time = (8/3 − 1) = 5/3 of original time

(5/3) × T = 10 ⇒ T = 10 × (3/5) = 6

**∴ Answer = 6 minutes**

Time ∝ 1/Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New time = T × (8/3)

⇒ Delay = New time − Normal time

⇒ T × (8/3) − T = 10

⇒ T(8/3 − 1) = 10

⇒ T × (5/3) = 10

⇒ T = 10 × (3/5) = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

Time is inversely proportional to speed for fixed distance

Ratio Concept

questions.question: If an item marked at ₹3,392 is sold for ₹1,696, then what is the discount percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe the given values: Marked Price = ₹3,392 and Selling Price = ₹1,696.

We can clearly see that 1,696 × 2 = 3,392, which means the Selling Price is exactly half of the Marked Price.

Therefore, the discount amount is also equal to the Selling Price (₹1,696).

Since the discount is exactly half of the Marked Price, the discount percentage is directly 50%.

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹3,392

Selling Price (SP) = ₹1,696

**Formula Used:**

Discount = MP − SP

Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100

 
 
 Marked Price (MP) = ₹3,392
 
 
 
 Selling Price = ₹1,696
 
 
 
 Discount = ₹1,696

 
 Discount % = (1696 ÷ 3392) × 100 = 50%

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = 3,392 − 1,696

⇒ Discount = 1,696

⇒ Discount % = (1,696 ÷ 3,392) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (1 ÷ 2) × 100

⇒ Discount % = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (or List Price) of an article. Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) − Discount.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are offered, the equivalent single discount percentage is given by: (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Relation between CP, MP, and Profit

The direct ratio between Cost Price (CP) and Marked Price (MP) can be calculated as: MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit %) ÷ (100 − Discount %).

questions.question: ₹1,071 is to be divided among three persons M, N and T. If the shares of M and N are in the ratio 3 : 9 and that of N and T are in the ratio 6 : 9, what is the share (in ₹) of N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given M : N = 3 : 9 = 1 : 3 and N : T = 6 : 9 = 2 : 3.

To find the combined ratio, multiply directly: M : N : T = (1 × 2) : (3 × 2) : (3 × 3) = 2 : 6 : 9.

Total ratio parts = 2 + 6 + 9 = 17 parts.

Share of N = (6 ÷ 17) × 1071.

Share of N = 6 × 63 = ₹378.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹378.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount to be divided = ₹1,071

Ratio of M to N = 3 : 9

Ratio of N to T = 6 : 9

 M: 2x N: 6x T: 9x 
• 
• 
• Total = ₹1071 (17x) 
• 
• 
• N's share = ? 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, simplify the given individual ratios.

⇒ M : N = 3 : 9 = 1 : 3

⇒ N : T = 6 : 9 = 2 : 3

⇒ To combine them, make the value of N equal in both ratios. The lowest common multiple of 3 and 2 is 6.

⇒ Multiply (M : N) by 2 → 1 × 2 : 3 × 2 = 2 : 6

⇒ Multiply (N : T) by 3 → 2 × 3 : 3 × 3 = 6 : 9

⇒ Now, the combined ratio is M : N : T = 2 : 6 : 9

⇒ Let the respective shares be 2x, 6x, and 9x.

⇒ Total share = 2x + 6x + 9x = 17x

⇒ According to the problem, 17x = 1071

⇒ x = 1071 ÷ 17 = 63

⇒ N's share = 6x = 6 × 63 = 378

**∴ The correct answer is ₹378.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Ratio

If A : B = a : b and B : C = c : d, then the combined ratio A : B : C = (a × c) : (b × c) : (b × d). This is done by equating the common term.

Duplicate & Triplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b², and the triplicate ratio is a³ : b³. Sub-duplicate is √a : √b.

Proportion Rule

If four quantities are in proportion (a : b = c : d), then the product of extremes equals the product of means (a × d = b × c).

A boy standing 12 m away from a flagpole observes the top of the pole at an angle of elevation of 60^circ . Find the height of the flagpole.

For a given angle of elevation θ, Height = Base × tan(θ).

Angle of elevation (θ) = 60°

 60° C (Boy) B (Bottom) A (Top) 12 m h = ?

⇒ √3 = h ÷ 12

Angle of Elevation vs Depression
